compatibility.detail: Roborock's comparison identifies Q5 Pro+ with DuoRoller brushes and a detachable mop; Q5+ has a single brush and no mop. Check the full model name on the robot or in the app before choosing a part.

compatibility.part: Robot filter vs. dock dust bag
compatibility.detail: The washable filter sits in the robot's dustbin. The disposable 2.5 L E12-rated dust bag sits in the RockDock Plus. They are different parts and cannot replace one another.
The Q5 Pro+ uses two parallel rubber rollers. Select a dual-roller replacement that names Q5 Pro+; do not substitute a single-bristle Q5+ brush.

The linked CHAIN PEAK kit lists Q5 Pro+ and includes six dock bags, but does not publish their capacity. Roborock specifies a 2.5 L E12-rated RockDock Plus bag. Check the bag collar and size against your original before buying.
Several third-party listings also name Q8 Max, Q5 Max+ or other models. This guide reports each seller's exact claim; it does not assume every component fits all models in a shared listing.

careTip: Rinse the washable robot filter with clean water only and let the filter and dustbin dry thoroughly before reinstalling. Remove and wash the mop cloth after use. Keep a dust bag installed whenever the auto-empty dock runs.

questions.question: Are Roborock Q5 Pro+ and Q5+ replacement parts the same?
questions.answer: Do not assume so. Roborock describes the Q5 Pro+ with DuoRoller brushes and a detachable mop, while its Q5+ comparison shows a single brush and no mop. Match each part to the full model name and the original component.

questions.question: Which filter does the Q5 Pro+ use?
questions.answer: The robot has a washable filter inside its dustbin. The RockDock Plus uses a separate disposable dust bag. The filter listing on this page is third-party and names Q5 Pro+; match its frame and latch to your original filter.

questions.question: What size dust bag does the Q5 Pro+ dock use?
questions.answer: Roborock specifies a 2.5 L E12-rated dust bag for RockDock Plus and says to replace it as required. The linked third-party kit names Q5 Pro+ but does not state bag capacity, so compare the collar and dimensions with your installed bag.

questions.question: Are these genuine Roborock replacement parts?
questions.answer: No. The linked filters, brushes, mop cloths and multi-part kit are third-party products; their Q5 Pro+ compatibility statements come from their Amazon sellers. The robot link is an Amazon Renewed refurbished listing, not a new robot offer.
